shortBio.en: Nirvana's center of gravity—and the uneasy face of alternative going mainstream.
shortBio.zh: Nirvana 的重心——以及另类变主流时的不安面孔。

whyHub.en: Not a multi-band hopper, but the person-node that makes the Grohl-era lineup version mean something.
whyHub.zh: 不是多队跳槽者，但是让 Grohl 时期阵容版本「意味深长」的人物节点。

body.en: Some hubs are bridges; Cobain is a fixed star. Pair this page with Grohl to read Nirvana as people + version, not only a brand name.
body.zh: 有的枢纽是桥；Cobain 是恒星。把此页与 Grohl 对照，才能把 Nirvana 读成「人 + 版本」，而不只是品牌名。
